sehemu: Part II: Members of Parliament, Constituencies and Election of Members
jina: Tenure of office of Members of Parliament
maudhui: (1) A Member of Parliament shall cease to be a Member and shall vacate his seat in the National Assembly upon the occurrence of any of the following events - (a) if any circumstance arises which, if he were not a Member, would cause him to be disqualified for election; (b) if the Member is elected President; (c) if the Member fails to attend three consecutive meetings of the National Assembly without the permission of the Speaker; (d) if it is established that he has contravened the provisions of the law concerning the ethics of public leaders; (e) if the Member is elected or appointed Vice-President; (f) if the Member ceases to be a member of the political party to which he belonged; or (g) in the case of a Member required to make a formal declaration of property, if he fails to make that formal declaration; provided that if a Member does not cease to be a Member by reason of any of the matters specified above and does not sooner resign or die, he shall continue to hold office as a Member until Parliament is dissolved. (2) Parliament may enact a law making provision to enable a Member to appeal in accordance with law against a decision certifying him to be of unsound mind or against a sentence of death or imprisonment.
